qe: In the Gaya tract the surveyor found a fine clear stream coming out of the hills through a narrow ravine, which he called the finest torrent seen in those parts. Which stream was it?
qh: गया क्षेत्र में सर्वेक्षक को पहाड़ियों से एक संकरी घाटी के रास्ते निकलती एक स्वच्छ धारा मिली, जिसे उन्होंने उन भागों का सबसे सुंदर झरना बताया। वह धारा कौन-सी थी?
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me nadiyon tatha chhoti dhaaraon ka bahut vistrit varnan milta hai, kyunki inhi ke sahare sinchai tatha aane-jaane ke raaste bante the. Ek sthal par pahadi ke niche se ek chhoti tatha bilkul saaf dhara nikal rahi thi, jiska naam Mangura tha; yah sankari ghati yaani narrow ravine se bahar aati thi tatha us daur me ise un bhaagon ka sabse sundar tatha saaf torrent maana gaya, kyunki isme paani baaki sabhi dharaon tatha nadiyon se zyada tatha saaf tha. Isi kshetra me aage ek aur chhoti dhara mili jiska naam Disbar tha, jise wahan ka ek thakur apni seema batata tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki Gaya ka ilaaka chhoti-chhoti pahadi dharaon se bhara hua tha, jo kheti tatha gaon ki zaruraton ke liye mahatvapurn thin. Exam point: Gaya kshetra ki sabse saaf tatha sabse sundar dhara ka naam Mangura tha; yah pahadi ki sankari ghati se nikal kar bahar aati thi tatha us daur me ise sabse saaf torrent maana gaya; isi kshetra me Disbar naam ki ek aur chhoti dhara bhi thi.

qe: How wide was the sandy channel of the Sakri river which the surveyor crossed about a mile and a half from Nawadeh?
qh: नवादा से लगभग डेढ़ मील दूर सर्वेक्षक ने साकरी नदी जिस रेतीले पाट को पार किया, वह लगभग कितना चौड़ा था?
oe: About six or seven hundred yards
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me sakri naam ki nadi ka chauda tatha retila pata mila. Nawadeh se lagbhag dedh mile door yah nadi tarche tareeke se paari ki gayi. Us samay us nadi ka paat ret se bhara hua tha tatha uski chaudai lagbhag chhah se saat sau gaj thi; lekin us mausam me usme paani bahut kam tha. Is kam paani ka istemal log kheti ke liye karte the - nadi ke paani ko chhoti-chhoti naharon yaani cuts ke zariye sinchai ki naharon me pahunchaya jaata tha, jo us ilake me bahut saari thin. Is tarah kshetra ki nadiyan barish ke samay chaudi tatha khatarnak ho jaati thin, lekin sookhe mausam me sinchai ka mukhya sahaara ban jaati thin. Exam point: sakri nadi ka retila paat lagbhag chhah se saat sau gaj chauda tha tatha us samay usme paani bahut kam tha; nadi ke paani ko chhoti cuts ke zariye sinchai ki naharon me pahunchaya jaata tha; us kshetra me aisi sinchai ki naharein bahut saari thin.

qe: A little over a mile from Nawadeh, by the side of an irrigation canal, the surveyor saw the most extensive deposit of what substance, which was carefully scraped by glass-makers and washermen?
qh: नवादा से लगभग एक मील आगे, सिंचाई की नहर के किनारे, सर्वेक्षक ने किस पदार्थ का सबसे विस्तृत जमाव देखा, जिसे काँच बनाने वाले तथा धोबी सावधानी से खुरचते थे?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan ke dauran ek mahatvapurn bhu-rasayanik nishan bhi mila. Nawadeh se thoda aage, sinchai wali nahar ke kinare, zameen ke ek chhote se hisse par soda ubharta yaani effloresce hota mila. Yah apne aap zameen me se nikalta hua soda us daur me sarvekshak ne jitne aise sthal dekhe the, un sabme sabse bada tatha sabse vistrit tha. Iska upyog do tarah ke kaamgar karte the - ek to kaanch yaani glass banane wale karigar, jinko soda kachcha maal chahiye hota tha, tatha doosre dhobi, jo ise kapde saaf karne yaani washing ke liye istemal karte the. Log ise turant khurach lete the, kyunki zameen me se nikla hua soda hawa tatha mausam ke asar se phir mitti me mil jaata tha. Exam point: Nawadeh se thoda aage nahar ke kinare soda ubharta hua mila, jo us daur ka sabse vistrit soda-sthal tha; ise kaanch banane wale karigar tatha dhobi khurach kar le jaate the; zameen se nikalta soda turant hi phir mitti me mil jaata tha, isliye use jaldi khuracha jaata tha.

qe: Which low narrow ridge of quartz, mixed with black dots, did the surveyor note about a mile and a half north of Akbarpur in the Gaya tract?
qh: गया क्षेत्र में अकबरपुर से लगभग डेढ़ मील उत्तर में सर्वेक्षक ने काले बिंदुओं से मिले क्वार्ट्ज़ की किस नीची संकरी कटक का उल्लेख किया?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan afsar ne pahadiyon tatha unke pattharon ka bahut vistrit varnan diya, kyunki inhi sthalon se khanij tatha patthar nikalte the. Akbarpur se lagbhag dedh mile uttar me kwartj yaani quartz ki ek nichhi tatha sankri kataar mili, jisme bade-bade daane aapas me jude hue the tatha unke beech kale-kale dot dikhte the; is kataar ko Serput ki pahadi kaha jaata tha. Isi kshetra me doosri taraf Kuri nadi thi; dahine or Kulana naam ki lambi kataar thi tatha uske pashchim sire se dakshin ki or Dhakni naam ka pattharon ka dher tha. Yah Dhakni wali choti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha chandi rang ki abhrak yaani mica ki plates se bani thi, jabki badi pahadi me hornblende ka bada bhaari patthar milta tha. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki is kshetra ki bhu-banawat alag-alag khanijon ka mel hai. Exam point: Akbarpur se dedh mile uttar me kwartj ki nichhi sankri kataar thi jise Serput ki pahadi kehte the, jisme bade daane tatha kale dot milte the; Dhakni ki choti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates se bani thi; Kulana naam ki lambi kataar bhi isi kshetra me thi.

qe: Which hill near Akbarpur, the larger one, consisted of masses of very fine hornblende, very heavy and found in lumps two or three feet in diameter?
qh: अकबरपुर के निकट कौन-सी बड़ी पहाड़ी बहुत महीन हॉर्नब्लेंड के सख्त तथा भारी पिंडों से बनी थी, जो दो-तीन फुट व्यास के टुकड़ों में मिलते थे?
e: Gaya kshetra ke pahadi ilake me har pahadi ke patthar alag-alag the tatha sarvekshak ne inhe alag-alag naamon se likha. Akbarpur ke paas do pahadiyan thin - ek chhoti tatha ek badi. Chhoti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates se bani thi; iske ulta badi pahadi aisi mitti se bani thi, jisme bahut mahin hornblende ke bade-bade pind milte the, jo do se teen foot vyas ke the tatha bahut bhaari the. Isi kshetra me Kulana pahadi ke pashchim sire par mahin daane wala kwartj mila, jo pahadi ke niche ke hisse me laal tatha upper ke hisse me safed tha. Aise antar dikhate hain ki pattharon ke rang tatha banaawat unke banne ke tareeke tatha unme mile dhatuon par nirbhar karte hain, isliye ek hi choti pahadi ke alag-alag hisson me alag patthar mil sakte hain. Exam point: Akbarpur ke nikat badi pahadi mahin hornblende ke do se teen foot vyas wale bhaari pindon se bani thi; chhoti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates ki thi; Kulana pahadi ke niche ka patthar laal tatha upar ka safed tha.

qe: Which tank, a mile and a half north of Nawadeh, with a Jain temple in its middle, was much choked with weeds?
qh: नवादा से डेढ़ मील उत्तर में कौन-सा तालाब था, जिसके बीच में जैन मंदिर था तथा जो बहुत अधिक खरपतवार से भरा पड़ा था?
e: Gaya kshetra me talaab tatha pokharon ka bhi mahatvapurn sthan tha, kyunki yahi gaon ki sinchai tatha puja ke kendra hote the. Nawadeh se lagbhag dedh mile uttar me Nakaur naam ka talaab tha. Yah talaab purab-pashchim ki taraf sabse zyada lamba tha tatha us daur me bahut saare paudhon se bhara hua tha, jisme nol-khumbha naam ka paudha khaas taur par phaila hua tha. Is talaab ke beech, ek chhote vargakar chabutre par ek gumbad wala mandir bana hua tha, jisme do purane tarashe patthar the tatha jahan manav pairon ke chinh bane the tatha unke charon or chhote abhilekh khude the. Us talaab ke beech pahunchne ke liye ek purani sadak tatha eenton ka bana saral pat tha, jo toota-phoota pada tha. Is tarah ek chhota talaab tatha uske beech ek mandir mil kar kshetra ke dharmik tatha krishi-jeevan ka chitra banate hain. Exam point: Nakaur talaab Nawadeh se dedh mile uttar me tha tatha uske beech sthit mandir me do purane tarashe patthar the; talaab purab-pashchim lamba tatha nol-khumbha paudhe se bhara hua tha; wahan pahunchne ke liye eenton ka ek purana tatha toota hua pat tha.

qe: In the mineral surveys of the Gaya belt in the early nineteenth century, mica mines were worked by vertical shafts in which the workmen descended by ladders made of what?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में गया पट्टी के खनिज-सर्वेक्षण में अभ्रक की खानें खड़ी खुदाइयों से चलाई जाती थीं, जिनमें मज़दूर किस चीज़ से बनी सीढ़ियों से नीचे उतरते थे?
oe: Single bamboos with their branches as steps
Iron rungs fixed in the rock
Leather straps hung from the surface
oh: एक-एक बाँस, जिनकी डालियाँ सीढ़ी के डंडे का काम करती थीं
चट्टान में जड़े लोहे के डंडे
लकड़ी की कीलों से बँधी रस्सियाँ
ऊपर से लटकाए चमड़े के पट्टे
e: Gaya tatha aas-paas ki pahadi patti me abhrak yaani mica ki khanein bahut purani thi tatha 19vein sadi ke shuruaati survey me yahan ki khanon ka varnan milta hai. Is kshetra me mica nikalne ka tarika bahut purana tatha khatarnak tha; kaamgaar zameen me khadi khudai yaani shaft banate the tatha usme utarne ke liye ek-ek baans ki seedhiyan istemal karte the; yahan ek-ek baans ki daaliyan seedhi ke dande ka kaam karti thin. Khan me bhari kuda tatha malbah ek taraf jama rehta tha tatha use hatane me dhyan nahi diya jaata tha. Mica ki sabse badi samasya yah thi ki uske bade tukde yaani tables nikalte samay toot jaate the, jisse keemti mal ka nuksan hota tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki us daur me khan-anveshan ki takneek kitni saral magar jokhim bhara thi. Exam point: Gaya kshetra ki mica khanon me kaamgar khadi khudai se neeche utarte the tatha ek-ek baans ki seedhiyan kaam me aati thi; bhari malbah hatane me dhyan nahi diya jaata tha; mica ke bade tukde nikalte samay toot jaate the.

qe: Which village in the Gaya area was the place where the people of the region procured rock crystal (phatik) in the early nineteenth century?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में गया क्षेत्र का कौन-सा गाँव वह स्थान था, जहाँ से क्षेत्र के लोग स्फटिक (फटिक) लेते थे?
e: Gaya kshetra me patthar tatha khanijon ki talaash purani rahi hai. 19vein sadi ke shuruaati survey me Akbarpur naam ke gaon ke ek vyapari ne bataya ki kshetra ke log rock crystal yaani phatik Buduya naam ke gaon ke nikat ek chhoti pahadi se lete hain tatha woh khud wahan ja chuka hai. Usi vyapari ke saath chal kar survey afsar ne yah khan dekhi. Phatik ek saaf tatha chamakdar patthar hota hai, jise log ratna jaisa keemti maan kar puja tatha saja me istemal karte the; isliye aisi khanon ki jaankari bahari logon ko keval sthanik vyapariyon ke zariye hi milti thi. Silao apne khaja ke liye, Sherghati apne sthan ke liye tatha Telarha anya kshetra ke liye jaane jaate hain. Exam point: Buduya gaon (Gaya kshetra) ke nikat ki pahadi se rock crystal yaani phatik milti thi tatha iski jaankari Akbarpur ke ek vyapari ne di; phatik ko log ratna jaisa keemti maan kar puja tatha saja me istemal karte the.

qe: The black stone quarried at the Paterkati hill near Gaya was chiefly used for making which objects?
qh: गया के निकट पत्थरकट्टी (पतेरकट्टी) पहाड़ी से निकाले गए काले पत्थर का मुख्य उपयोग किन वस्तुओं को बनाने में होता था?
e: Gaya ke nikat Paterkati, jise aaj Pattharkatti kaha jaata hai, us pahadi par kale potstone yaani kathor kale patthar ki khan thi. Is patthar ki khaas baat yah thi ki woh bahut kathor tatha bareek dane wala tha, isliye usse mukhya roop se musal (pestle) tatha okhli (mortar) yaani kutne-pisne ke auzaar banaye jaate the. Us daur me is patthar ka ek aur naam bhi prachalit tha - 'Kolapatur' yaani kala patthar. Usi kshetra me ek badi khan thi jahan se nikalne wala patthar Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me kaam aaya; yah bataya jaata hai ki us kaam ke liye kaarigaron ko Jaynagar se bulaya gaya tha. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi me bhi patthar ki khan tatha patthar tarashna Gaya kshetra ka bada rozgaar tha. Exam point: Paterkati yaani Pattharkatti pahadi (Gaya) ka kala potstone musal tatha okhli banane ke liye istemal hota tha tatha usi patthar ka doosra naam 'Kolapatur' tha; usi kshetra ka patthar Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me bhi kaam aaya tatha kaarigar Jaynagar se bulaye gaye.

qe: Stone from a quarry worked by men brought from Jaynagar was used to erect which famous temple at Gaya?
qh: जयनगर से लाए गए कारीगरों द्वारा चलाई गई खान का पत्थर गया के किस प्रसिद्ध मंदिर के निर्माण में लगा था?
e: Gaya ke nikat ki pahadiyon me ek bahut hi sundar khan thi, jahan se hornblende naam ka sakht tatha chamakdar patthar nikalta tha; is patthar ki khaas baat thi ki iske bade-bade crystal milte the. Isi patthar se Gaya ka prasiddh Vishnupad mandir banwaya gaya, isliye us khan ka naam hi 'Vishnupad' pad gaya tatha us kaam ke liye kaarigaron ko Jaynagar se bulaya gaya. Us daur me patthar tatha khanijon ka kaam Gaya kshetra ka bada rozgaar tha; isiliye jab patthar ki maang kam hui, to kaamgaar murtiyan, cup-plate tatha musal-okhli banane lage. Isi kshetra me Paterkati (Pattharkatti) pahadi se kala potstone nikalta tha, jisse kutne-pisne ke auzaar bante the. Exam point: Jaynagar se bulaye gaye kaarigaron wali khan ka hornblende patthar Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me laga tatha us khan ka naam 'Vishnupad' pad gaya; patthar ki maang kam hone par kaamgaar murtiyan tatha musal-okhli banane lage.

qe: Lime for the bridge at Fatuha was got in the early nineteenth century from a hill near Gaya, where which lime-bearing material was dug and burnt?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में फतुहा के पुल के लिए चूना गया के निकट की एक पहाड़ी से लिया गया, जहाँ कौन-सी चूना-युक्त सामग्री खोद कर जलाई जाती थी?
e: Gaya kshetra ki pahadiyon me safed tatha danedar padarth ki kaafi moti paren milti thin, jise calcareous marl kaha jaata tha; us daur ke kaamgar ise 'Chunapatar' ke naam se bhi jaante the. Ise jalane par achha chuna (lime) banta tha tatha yah chuna imaraton me jodne tatha plastar banane ke kaam aata tha. Bataya jaata hai ki Fatuha ke pul ke nirman me isi chune ka istemal hua, isliye us khan ki khudai kaafi badi thi. Usi kshetra me marl ke andar safed jasper ke gol tukde bhi milte the tatha marl ki paren ek kathor granite wale pahad se ghiri thin; is tarah ek hi sthal par kai khanij aur patthar ek saath milte the. Exam point: Fatuha ke pul ke liye chuna Gaya ke nikat ki pahadi se milne wale safed calcareous marl se banaya gaya, jise kaamgar 'Chunapatar' kehte the; isi marl ke andar safed jasper ke gol tukde bhi milte the.

qe: A tradition recorded at the Gaya stone quarry said that the quarry was first worked by which Raja, who built Rohtas and the Barabar caves and later sent his workmen south?
qh: गया की पत्थर-खान में मिली एक परंपरा के अनुसार वह खान सबसे पहले किस राजा ने चलाई, जिन्होंने रोहतास तथा बराबर की गुफाएँ बनवाईं और बाद में अपने कारीगरों को दक्षिण भेज दिया?
e: Gaya kshetra ki patthar khanon se judi ek lok-parampara bhi prachalit thi. Is parampara ke mutabik us khan me kaam sabse pehle Harchand Rajah ne shuru kiya tha. Kaha jaata tha ki unhone Rohtas ka kila tatha Barabar ki gufayen banwai thin, lekin jab unhe yahan ka patthar bahut sakht laga, to unhone yah kaam chhod diya tatha apne kaamgar dakshin bharat me Ellora bhej diye, jahan unhone chattanon me bahut bade kaam kiye. Aisi lok-kathayein dikhati hain ki purane shilp tatha khan-karm ka gyaan kaise pidhi-dar-pidhi chalata aaya tatha kaarigar ek kshetra se doosre kshetra tak jaate rahe. Aaj bhi Pattharkatti kshetra ki patthar tarashne ki kala usi purani gaath ka hissa maani jaati hai. Exam point: Gaya ki khan ki lok-parampara me Harchand Rajah ko pehla khan-sanchalak bataya jaata hai, jinhone Rohtas ka kila tatha Barabar ki gufayen banwai thin; patthar sakht milne par unhone apne kaamgar Ellora (dakshin bharat) bhej diye; Pattharkatti ki patthar-kala usi parampara se judi maani jaati hai.

qe: On the hill called Baluya near Gaya, the heavy blackish potstone quarried by the workmen was known by which name?
qh: गया के निकट बालुया पहाड़ी पर मज़दूर जिस भारी काले पॉटस्टोन को निकालते थे, उसे किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Gaya kshetra ki pahadiyon me kai kism ke patthar ek saath milte the. Baluya naam ki pahadi ki dakshin-pashchim taraf bahut bhaari tatha kale potstone ki teen khanein thin; kaam karne wale majdoor is patthar ko 'Song Musa' yaani Musa ka patthar kehte the. Yah patthar chhote-chhote tukdon me milta tha, uske upar ek sadne wali bhuri parat chadhi hoti thi tatha woh paren yaani veins ke roop me nikalta tha, jinke upar tatha dono taraf safed marl ki moti parat hoti thi. Usi kshetra me Paterkatti pahadi ka kala patthar 'Kolapatur' kehlata tha, jisse musal tatha okhli bante the, tatha marl ko 'Chunapatar' kaha jaata tha. Is tarah ek hi kshetra me kai pattharon ke apne-apne sthanik naam the. Exam point: Baluya pahadi ke bhaari kale potstone ko majdoor 'Song Musa' kehte the; yah patthar paren me milta tha tatha uske upar safed marl ki moti parat hoti thi; usi kshetra ke Paterkatti patthar ka naam 'Kolapatur' tatha marl ka naam 'Chunapatar' tha.

qe: Which hill near Gaya yielded a very hard blackstone so impregnated with silicious matter that it was used for making pestles and mortars and was called simply 'black stone'?
qh: गया के निकट कौन-सी पहाड़ी से ऐसा बहुत कठोर काला पत्थर निकलता था, जिसमें सिलिका इतनी मिली थी कि वह मूसल तथा ओखली बनाने के काम आता था और उसे साधारण रूप से 'काला पत्थर' कहा जाता था?
e: Gaya ke nikat Paterkati pahadi, jise aaj Pattharkatti ke naam se jaana jaata hai, wahan ka patthar bahut kathor tha. Iske adhiktar hisse me bareek dane wala kala potstone milta tha, jisme silicious hornstone yaani silika wala sakht padarth itna mila hua tha ki usme chamakdar tootne wali banawat (conchoidal fracture) dikhti thi. Isi kaaran yah patthar musal tatha okhli banane ke liye bahut upyukt tha tatha kaamgar ise sirf 'kala patthar' yaani Kolapatur kehte the. Usi kshetra me Baluya pahadi par 'Song Musa' naam ka potstone tatha 'Chunapatar' naam ka safed marl bhi milta tha. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki Gaya kshetra me patthar ka kaam itna vikasit tha ki wahan ke majdoor pattharon ko apne-apne alag naam se pehchante the. Exam point: Paterkatti pahadi ka kathor kala potstone silicious hornstone se mila hua tha, isliye woh musal tatha okhli banane ke liye upyukt tha tatha use 'Kolapatur' yaani kala patthar kaha jaata tha; Baluya ka patthar 'Song Musa' tatha safed marl 'Chunapatar' kehlata tha.

qe: On the summit of the larger hill of Jaynagar stood a ruin called Indrayavan's house with an inner court about fifteen yards square; what was the small chamber of large squared stones at its north-east angle called?
qh: जयनगर की बड़ी पहाड़ी की चोटी पर इंद्रयावन के घर नाम का खंडहर था, जिसके भीतरी आँगन का विस्तार लगभग पंद्रह गज़ का चौकोर था; इसके उत्तर-पूर्व कोने पर बड़े तराशे पत्थरों से बने छोटे कक्ष को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Jaynagar ki badi pahadi ke shikhar par Indrayavan ka ghar kahlane wali imarat ke avshesh the. Uske do hisse ya do aangan the; bhitari aangan lagbhag pandrah gaz ka chaukor tha tatha uske charon aur eenton ki moti deewar ya imaraton ki patli kaatarein thin, jinki tabahi se dekhne me ek prachar jaisa roop ban gaya tha. Iske uttar-poorv kone par, bahar ki or nikalti hui, bade tarashe pattharon se bani ek chhoti kothri thi. Us kothri ke andar ki jagah lagbhag das foot chaukor thi tatha uski deewarein aath foot moti thin, isliye woh ek bahut hi mazboot surakshit kamre jaisi dikhti thi. Us kamre ko Raja ka kaksh kaha jaata tha. Exam point: Jaynagar ki badi pahadi par Indrayavan ke ghar ke uttar-poorv kone par bade tarashe pattharon ka ek chhota kamra tha, jise Raja ka kaksh kaha jaata tha; uski deewarein aath foot moti tatha andar ki jagah das foot chaukor thi.

qe: The small stone strong-room on the Jaynagar hill was too confined for a raja's residence and had no water for withstanding a siege; the surveyor therefore thought its object was to secure what against thieves?
qh: जयनगर की पहाड़ी पर बना छोटा पत्थर का मज़बूत कक्ष किसी राजा के रहने के लिए बहुत तंग था तथा घेराबंदी झेलने के लिए उसमें पानी भी नहीं था; इसलिए सर्वेक्षक के विचार से इसका उद्देश्य चोरों से किसकी रक्षा करना था?
oe: The revenue collected in the district
The grain store of the fort
oh: जिले में वसूल किया गया राजस्व
e: Chhota patthar ka kamra itna tang tha ki kisi bhi raja ke rahne ke liye woh upyukt nahi tha, chahe woh kitne hi bhay me jeevan bitata ho. Jaynagar ke paas Gidhaur me itni badi haveli rakhne wale Indrayavan jaise vyakti ke liye aise tang kamre me saans lena bhi sambhav nahi tha. Usme pani bhi nahi tha, isliye woh dushman ke ghere yaani siege me tikne ke liye nahi banaya gaya tha. In tarkon ke aadhar par anuman lagaya gaya ki imarat ka uddeshya rajasv yaani aay ko choron se bachana tha, kyunki us samay Bharat ke chor chori ke kaam me duniya ke baaki deshon ke choron se bahut zyada chalak maane jaate the. Exam point: tang aakar tatha pani ki suvidha na hone ke kaaran patthar ka kamra ghare ko jhelne ke liye nahi tha; anuman lagaya gaya ki uska uddeshya vasool kiye gaye rajasv ko choron se bachana tha.

qe: What did the surveyor regard as strong evidence that the ruined city beside the Jaynagar hills had once been very large, perhaps three miles in diameter even after the hills were deducted?
qh: सर्वेक्षक के अनुसार जयनगर की पहाड़ियों के पास बसा खंडहर नगर कभी बहुत बड़ा रहा होगा, जिसका व्यास पहाड़ियाँ छोड़ने के बाद भी शायद तीन मील था; इसका पक्का प्रमाण क्या था?
oe: The brick heaps lying in every direction
The numerous small tanks extending about a mile all round the hill
The stone rampart round the hill top
The lofty temple on the opposite bank of the river
oh: हर ओर बिखरे ईंटों के ढेर
पहाड़ी के चारों ओर लगभग एक मील तक फैले अनेक छोटे तालाब
पहाड़ी की चोटी के चारों ओर पत्थर की प्राचीर
नदी के दूसरे किनारे का ऊँचा मंदिर
e: Jaynagar ki pahadi ke charon or lagbhag ek mile tak chhote-chhote talaab bikhre hue the; sirf wahan jagah kam thi jahan Kiyol nadi ne sthal ko simit kar diya tha. Nagar ke avshesh me bhar ke dhair bhi the, lekin unme se koi dhair itna bada nahi tha jisse bade bhavan ya mandir ke alawa kisi badi imarat ka pata chale, isliye unse nagar ke vistaar ka anuman lagana mushkil tha. Chunki har chhota talaab pani ki suvidha tatha basne ke vistaar ka sanket deta hai, inhe nagar ke bade vistaar ka pukhta praman maana gaya; is hisaab se nagar ka vyas lagbhag teen mile ka tha. Anuman lagaya gaya ki yah sthal Ganga ke kinare ke ek bade jile ke rajasv-prabandhak adhikari ka nivas hoga, kyunki yah baadhi kshetra ki seema par tha tatha har mausam me Gidhaur ke paas ki rajdhani se rabta rakhta tha. Exam point: pahadi ke charon or ek mile tak phaile anek chhote talaab nagar ke bade vistaar ka praman the; is hisaab se uska vyas lagbhag teen mile ka tha tatha woh ek rajasv-prabandhak adhikari ka nivas hua hoga.

qe: The rock of the Jaynagar hill, where whole and undecayed, resembled the hard stone of the millstone quarry at Lobeta, being small masses of fat quartz united by a greyish powdery substance; the surveyor therefore held that it was granite in what state?
qh: जयनगर की पहाड़ी की चट्टान, जहाँ साबुत तथा बिना क्षय की हालत में थी, लोबेटा की चक्की-पत्थर खदान के कठोर पत्थर जैसी थी, अर्थात् मोटे क्वार्ट्ज़ के छोटे-छोटे टुकड़े जो भूरे चूर्ण जैसे पदार्थ से जुड़े थे; इसलिए सर्वेक्षक का मत था कि यह ग्रेनाइट किस अवस्था में था?
oe: A state formed by river deposit
oh: नदी की जमावट से बनी अवस्था में
e: Granite ek aisi chattan hai jo mukhyatah teen khanijon se banti hai - quartz, felspar tatha mica. Quartz ek safed ya rangeen, bahut kathor tatha chamakdar khanij hai, jo ret tatha patthar ka mukhya hissa hota hai. Felspar halka rangeen khanij hota hai tatha mica abhrak kehlata hai, jiski patli paratein chamakti hain. Jaynagar ki pahadi ki chattan, jahan sabut bachi thi, Lobeta ke chakki-patthar ki khaadaan ke patthar jaisi thi, yaani mote quartz ke chhote-chhote tukde, jo ek bhure churn jaise padarth se jude the tatha kuch jagah laal bhi the. Pahadi ke bikhre tukdon me kuch laal rang ke the, kuch loha-galane ke mail jaise the, tatha kuch me felspar jaisa tha. In tathyon se anuman lagaya gaya ki yah poori chattan kabhi granite thi, jisme quartz sabut bacha raha tatha baaki hisse badal gaye; is sthiti ko imperfect state of fusion yaani apurn sangalan kaha gaya. Exam point: Jaynagar ki chattan Lobeta ki chakki-patthar khaadaan ke patthar jaisi thi; quartz sabut tatha baaki khanij badle hue dekh kar anuman lagaya gaya ki yah granite apurn sangalan ki avastha me thi.

qe: The imperfect quartz or silicious hornstone of this tract showed white, red and black shades; the red tint was attributed to iron and the black colour to an intermixture of which mineral?
qh: इस क्षेत्र के अपूर्ण क्वार्ट्ज़ या सिलिसियस हॉर्नस्टोन में सफ़ेद, लाल तथा काली छटाएँ दिखती थीं; लाल रंग का कारण लोहा माना गया तथा काला रंग किस खनिज के मेल से माना गया?
e: Is kshetra me milne wali chattan ka bada hissa ek apurna quartz ya silicious hornstone tha, yaani silica se bani kathor chattan. Uski chhataein jagah-jagah alag-alag thin - kahin safed, kahin laal tatha kahin kaali - tatha inke beech aise-kai milay huye rang bhi dikhte the. Laal rang ka kaaran loha maana gaya, kyunki laal rang loha-jang ke karan padta hai. Kaale rang ka kaaran amianthus naam ke khanij ka mel bataya gaya. Amianthus ek reshadaar khanij hai, jiske bahut patle reshite silk ki tarah chamakte hain; kisi namune me ye reshite saaf dikhte the. Kuch jagah chattan ke dane bahut barik tatha ek jaise the, jabki kuch jagah chattan saaf taur par alag-alag hisson ka mel dikhti thi, jaise glassy kan tatha powder jaisa hissa. Exam point: laal rang loha se tatha kaala rang amianthus naam ke reshadaar khanij ke mel se maana gaya; amianthus ek reshadaar khanij hai jiske silk jaise patle reshite dikhte hain.

qe: Bihar accounts for roughly what share of India's pyrite resources, and where is its most important deposit located?
qh: भारत के पाइराइट संसाधनों में बिहार का हिस्सा लगभग कितना है और उसका सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण भंडार कहाँ है?
e: Pyrite Bihar ka sabse khaas khanij hai aur desh ke pyrite sansadhano ka lagbhag 94 pratishat hissa Bihar me hai; isi liye ise Bihar ka 'monopoly' khanij kaha ja sakta hai. Iska sabse pramukh bhandar Rohtas jile ke Amjhore kshetra me hai, jahan Kurari, Manda tatha Kariria jaise mining blocks bhi aate hain. Amjhore pyrite Vindhyan rock belt se juda hai. Pyrite ka mukhya upyog sulphur ke srot ke roop me hota hai, jisse sulfuric acid banta hai; sulfuric acid aage urvarak (fertiliser) tatha rasayanik udyog me kaam aata hai, isliye pyrite ka sambandh kheti tatha chemical industry se bhi juda hai. Sono (Jamui) Bihar ka sona (gold) wala kshetra hai, Kharagpur Hills (Munger) bauxite ke liye jaani jaati hai tatha Rajauli (Nawada) mica ka kshetra hai - isliye baaki vikalp anya khanijon se jude hain. Exam point: pyrite me Bihar ka hissa lagbhag 94%, mukhya sthal Amjhore (Rohtas), Vindhyan belt; isse sulfuric acid tatha urvarak banta hai.

qe: Bihar's traditional gold-bearing area 'Sono' is located in which district?
qh: बिहार का पारंपरिक स्वर्ण-क्षेत्र 'सोनो' किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Bihar me sona (gold) nikalne ka pramukh tatha paramparik kshetra Jamui jile ka Sono hai; yahan Precambrian hard-rock terrain tatha quartz reefs me gold ke kane milte hain. Purani National Mineral Inventory (NMI) ki jaankari me Bihar ka primary gold ore resource share lagbhag 44 pratishat bataya gaya tha, lekin dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki yah 'ore resource' ka hissa hai, saaf dhate (gold metal) ka nahi - isliye ise seedha 44 pratishat sona maan lena galat hota hai. Karmatiya, Boutha tatha Mahugaon jaise kshetra recent exploration me shaamil hain, isliye Jamui ko Bihar me svarn-jila ke roop me yaad rakhna chahiye. Nawada mica ke liye, Rohtas pyrite tatha limestone ke liye aur Munger bauxite ke liye jaana jaata hai; inme kisi ka bhi mukhya khanij sona nahi hai. Isi tarah ke prashnon me khanij-district ki jodi banti hai, isliye jodi yaad rakhna sabse upyogi hai. Exam point: Bihar me svarn (gold) ka mukhya kshetra = Sono, Jamui; 'ore resource 44%' ko gold metal ka share na samjhein.

qe: Which district is the principal mica-bearing district of Bihar?
qh: बिहार का मुख्य अभ्रक (mica) उत्पादक जिला कौन-सा है?
e: Bihar me mica (abhrak) ka pramukh kshetra Nawada jila hai; yahan Rajauli tatha Chatkari jaise sthalon me mica milta hai. Mica Precambrian metamorphic rocks tatha pegmatite-bearing zones se juda hota hai, isliye mahatvapurn kshetra purane hard-rock bhoogol me hain. Mica ki khaas baat yah hai ki uski vidyut tatha tapa-rodhak (insulation) ke liye badee keemiyat hai. Dhyaan dene wali baat yah hai ki aksar 'Bhagalpur-mica' ki jodi galat taur par likhi jaati hai; isliye is soch mein Bhagalpur ko blindly sahi na maanein. Gaya tatha Kaimur me dolomite, pyrite tatha limestone jaisi khanijein zyada mahatvapurn hain, woh mica ke mukhya kendra nahi hain. Jain is tarah ke prashnon me pariksha 'trap' lagati hai, isliye mica ka sahi jila Nawada hi yaad rakhna chahiye. Exam point: Bihar me abhrak (mica) ka mukhya jila = Nawada (Rajauli, Chatkari); Bhagalpur-mica ki jodi par andhadhund vishwas na karein.

qe: Bauxite, the ore of aluminium, is mined in Bihar mainly from:
qh: एल्यूमिनियम का अयस्क बॉक्साइट बिहार में मुख्यतः कहाँ से निकाला जाता है?
e: Bihar me bauxite ka pramukh kshetra Munger jile ki Kharagpur Hills hai. Bauxite aluminium ka mukhya ore hai, jise lateritic weathering tatha purane hard-rock terrain se juda maana jaata hai - yaani lambe samay tak barsaat tatha garam mausam se chattano ka rasayanik apkashan (weathering) hone par bauxite banta hai. Bharat ka aluminium udyog bauxite par hi tika hai, kyunki isse aluminiyam dhatu nikaalne ke alava cement, refractory tatha rasayan me bhi prayog hota hai. Amjhore (Rohtas) pyrite tatha Banjari (Kaimur) limestone ka kshetra hai; Sono (Jamui) svarn wala kshetra hai - isliye woh teeno vikalp anya khanijon ke liye jane jaate hain. Yaad rakhne ka aasan tarika yahi hai ki Bihar ke khanij-district jode sabse zyada poochhe jaate hain, isliye har khanij ke saath uske jile ka naam ek saath yaad karein. Exam point: bauxite = Kharagpur Hills (Munger); pyrite = Amjhore (Rohtas); svarn = Sono (Jamui); chuna-pattar = Banjari/Kalyanpur/Murli Pahari (Kaimur-Rohtas belt).

qe: The NTPC Barh Super Thermal Power Station, with a commissioned capacity of 3,300 MW and located on the bank of the Ganga, is in which district?
qh: 3,300 मेगावाट क्षमता वाला एनटीपीसी बाढ़ सुपर थर्मल पावर स्टेशन, जो गंगा के तट पर स्थित है, किस जिले में है?
e: Barh Super Thermal Power Station Patna jile ke Barh kshetra me Ganga nadi ke kinare sthit hai aur yah NTPC dwara sanchalit koyla-adharit super thermal station hai; iski commissioned capacity 3,300 megawatt hai. Aise bade coal station ke liye do cheezein sabse zaroori hoti hain - bharosemand paani (cooling ke liye, yahan Ganga) aur koyla pahunchane ki suvidha (rail tatha sadak). Barh ka paani Ganga se tatha koyla Coal India ki mines se aata hai. Bihar ko Barh stage-1 tatha stage-2 se lagbhag 1,700 megawatt ki firm allocation milti hai, isliye Bihar ke bijli-mishran me is station ka bada yogdaan hai. Bhagalpur me Kahalgaon, Begusarai me Barauni tatha Muzaffarpur me Kanti station hai - isliye baaki teen vikalp anya kshetron ke station hai. Exam point: Barh STPS = Patna jila, Ganga ke tat par, NTPC, 3,300 MW; Kahalgaon = Bhagalpur (2,340 MW), Barauni = Begusarai, Kanti = Muzaffarpur.

qe: The NTPC Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station, with an installed capacity of 2,340 MW, draws its cooling water from the Ganga and receives coal from which coalfields?
qh: 2,340 मेगावाट क्षमता वाला एनटीपीसी कहलगांव सुपर थर्मल पावर स्टेशन गंगा से ठंडा जल लेता है तथा कोयला किन कोयला-क्षेत्रों से प्राप्त करता है?
oe: Rajmahal coalfields of Eastern Coalfields Limited
e: Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station Bhagalpur jile ke Kahalgaon kshetra me Ganga nadi ke kinare sthit hai; Bihar ka yah ek badi koyla-adharit bijli-station hai jaisa varnan aksar parikshaon me aata hai. Iski installed capacity 2,340 megawatt hai, jo 4 guna 210 megawatt tatha 3 guna 500 megawatt units me bani hai. Iska cooling water Ganga se milta hai tatha koyla Rajmahal coalfields (Eastern Coalfields Limited) se rail ke zariye pahunchta hai - yahi bhoogol tatha indhan ka khaas sangam is station ko jaanta hai. Amjhore mines pyrite ke liye prasiddh hain, Pachra block North Karanpura ka hissa hai jo BRBCL Nabinagar ko koyla deta hai, aur Chatti-Bariatu mines NTPC dwara Barh stage-2 ke liye jani jaati hain - isliye baaki teen vikalp anya projects se jude hain. Exam point: Kahalgaon STPS = Bhagalpur, Ganga water plus Rajmahal coalfields (ECL), 2,340 MW (4x210 MW aur 3x500 MW).

qe: Bihar's first floating solar power plant, set up by BREDA over a water body, is located at:
qh: ब्रेडा द्वारा जल-निकाय पर स्थापित बिहार का पहला तैरता (floating) सौर ऊर्जा संयंत्र स्थित है -
e: Bihar ka pehla floating solar power plant Darbhanga jile ke Kadirabad talab (water body) par lagaya gaya hai; iski capacity 2 megawatt hai aur ise BREDA (Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency) ne vikasit kiya. 'Floating solar' ka matlab hai ki solar panels zameen par nahi, paani ki satah par tairte platformon par lage hote hain. Iske do bade laabh hain - pehla, keemti zameen bachti hai jo kheti ya aur kaam me lag sakti hai; doosra, paani ke upar hone se panel thande rehte hain aur unki karyakshamta badh jaati hai. Yah yojna bahut important hai kyunki Bihar me zameen ki availability seemit hai, isliye jal-aashayon (talab, chaurs) par solar lagana smart upaay hai. Barh tatha Kanti koyla-adharit thermal stations ke kshetra hain jo patna tatha Muzaffarpur me hain, aur Nabinagar (Aurangabad) me bhi koyla-adharit projects hain - isliye woh sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ka pehla floating solar plant = Kadirabad, Darbhanga (2 MW, BREDA); laabh = zameen ki bachat tatha panel ka thanda rehna.

qe: At Nabinagar in Aurangabad district, which thermal project has been developed by BRBCL as a joint venture of NTPC and Indian Railways, and what is its capacity?
qh: औरंगाबाद जिले के नवीनगर में, एनटीपीसी तथा भारतीय रेलवे के संयुक्त उपक्रम बीआरबीसीएल ने कौन-सी ताप विद्युत परियोजना विकसित की है, और उसकी क्षमता कितनी है?
oe: 1,000 MW (4 x 250 MW), with Indian Railways as the main beneficiary
1,980 MW (3 x 660 MW), run by NPGC
2 MW floating solar plant of BREDA
oh: 1,000 मेगावाट (4 x 250 मेगावाट), जिसमें भारतीय रेलवे मुख्य लाभार्थी है
1,980 मेगावाट (3 x 660 मेगावाट), एनपीजीसी द्वारा संचालित
ब्रेडा का 2 मेगावाट तैरता सौर संयंत्र
e: Aurangabad jile ke Nabinagar me do alag-alag thermal projects hain, isliye inhe mila dena aam galti hai. Pehla - Nabinagar STPP-1, jise NPGC (Nabinagar Power Generating Company) chalati hai; iski capacity 1,980 megawatt hai tatha yah 3 guna 660 megawatt units me bana hai; iska paani Sone nadi se Indrapuri Barrage ke through aata hai. Doosra - BRBCL (Bhartiya Rail Bijlee Company Limited) ka Nabinagar Thermal Power Project, jo NTPC tatha Indian Railways ka 74:26 ke anupat me saahsi (joint venture) hai; iski capacity 1,000 megawatt (4 guna 250 megawatt) hai. Sabse khaas baat yah hai ki BRBCL ke utpadan ka 90 pratishat hissa Indian Railways tatha 10 pratishat Bihar rajya ko milta hai, isliye yah railon ki bijli ki zaroorat padti hai. Iske koyle ki supply North Karanpura ke Pachra tatha Pachra South blocks (CCL) se hoti hai. Exam point: BRBCL Nabinagar = 1,000 MW (4x250), NTPC tatha Indian Railways ka 74:26 JV, Railways 90% beneficiary, CCL ka Pachra koyla; NPGC Nabinagar = 1,980 MW (3x660), Sone/Indrapuri paani.

qe: In the hills between Nawadeh and the Gaya survey tract, the western extremity of Sujur, called Dilawa, consisted chiefly of which rock, with fine white grains and black dots on top?
qh: नवादा तथा गया सर्वेक्षण क्षेत्र के बीच की पहाड़ियों में सुजुर के पश्चिमी सिरे, जिसे दिलावा कहा जाता था, मुख्यतः किस चट्टान से बना था, जिसकी चोटी पर बारीक सफेद दाने तथा काले बिंदु थे?
e: Bihar ke is pahadi ilake me pattharon ki banaawat ka bahut vistrit vivran milta hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki thode hi antar par alag-alag patthar milte the. Nawadeh aur Gaya ke sarvekshan kshetra ke beech ki pahadiyon me Sujur ka pashchim sira, jise Dilawa kaha jaata tha, mukhya roop se kwartj yaani quartz ka tha. Is pahadi ki choti par patthar bareek safed daanon ka tha, jisme kale bindu tatha dararon me thodi abhrak yaani mica bhi mili hui thi. Pahadi ke beech ke hisse me kwartj theek-theek chamakdar tha, jisme laal rang ka padarth mila hua tha, tatha pahadi ke neeche ke hisse me kwartj aur bhi zyada saaf tatha chamakdar tha. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki ek hi pahadi par upar se niche tak patthar ka svarup badalta gaya tatha lakshan purane tapt-prakriya ke kaam ki or sanket karte hain. Exam point: Sujur ke pashchim sire Dilawa par mukhya roop se kwartj yaani quartz mila; choti par bareek safed daane tatha kale bindu the tatha dararon me mica bhi thi; pahadi ke madhya hisse ka kwartj laal padarth ke saath tatha niche ka hissa zyada chamakdar tha.

qe: Which rock, described in the survey as a granite of hornblende and white quartz, was found at Dhirkarghat in the middle of the same Gaya ridge?
qh: उसी गया कटक के मध्य में धीरकरघाट पर कौन-सी चट्टान मिली, जिसे हॉर्नब्लेंड तथा सफेद क्वार्ट्ज़ का ग्रेनाइट बताया गया है?
oe: A granite of hornblende and white quartz
A rude jasper, reddish and white
oh: हॉर्नब्लेंड तथा सफेद क्वार्ट्ज़ का ग्रेनाइट
e: Is pahadi ilake me har sthal ka patthar alag bataya gaya hai, jisse ek hi lambi kataar ke andar kai tarah ki chattanein hone ka pata chalta hai. Dilawa ke baad wahin Sujur kataar ke madhya me Dhirkarghat naam ke sthal par hornblende tatha safed quartz ka granite mila; hornblende ek gehra hara-kala khanij hota hai tatha quartz safed tatha chamakdar, isliye in dono ke milne se bana granite bhura rang ka tatha bahut sakht hota hai. Isi kshetra me Hurkarghat ke uttar me sthit chhoti pahadi Snnha shisht jaisi abhrak yaani mica ki thi, tatha us badi kataar ke saamne wali sabhi chhoti pahadiyan us badi kataar se bhi zyada uthal-puthal tatha khadki thin. Isi kshetra me agle sthal Bonsaha par laal tatha safed rang ka apari-shkrit jasper mila, jiski satah par kwartj ke adhure chhote-chhote daane the. Exam point: Dhirkarghat par hornblende tatha safed quartz ka granite mila; Hurkarghat ke uttar ki chhoti pahadi Snnha shisht jaisi abhrak ki thi tatha saamne wali chhoti pahadiyan badi kataar se bhi zyada rugne-daari wali thin; agle sthal Bonsaha me laal-safed apari-shkrit jasper mila.

qe: How did the people of the Patna-Bihar tract collect the soda which effloresced in the soil, as described in the 1811-12 survey?
qh: 1811-12 के सर्वेक्षण में वर्णित अनुसार पटना-बिहार क्षेत्र के लोग मिट्टी में उभरने वाले सोडे को कैसे इकट्ठा करते थे?
oe: They collected it from the leaves of the palm trees
They dug deep wells and pumped it out
They scraped it off and threw it together in a shallow pit with water so that a crust formed on the surface
They burnt the soil in kilns and washed the ash
oh: वे उसे ताड़ के पत्तों से इकट्ठा करते थे
वे गहरे कुएँ खोदकर पानी निकालते थे
वे उसे खुरचकर पानी भरे उथले गड्ढे में डालते थे, ताकि सतह पर परत जम जाए
वे मिट्टी को भट्ठी में जलाकर राख धोते थे
e: Is kshetra ki mitti me soda apne aap ubharta yaani effloresce hota tha tatha logon ne uske sangrah ka apna tarika bana liya tha. Woh zameen par ubhri hui safed parat ko sawdhani se khurach lete the tatha usay ek uthle gadhe me pani ke saath daal dete the; us pani ki satah par soda ki ek parat jam jaati thi, jise aasani se uthaya ja sakta tha. Yah tarika jile ke kai hisson me chalta tha; jahan zameen me soda zyada tha, jaise ek gaon se agle gaon tak lagbhag dedh mile tak, wahan parat ek hi jagah sabse zyada jama hoti thi tatha uske khurachne se log apni zarurat poori karte the. Sthaneey roop se nikalne wale is soda ka faayda kaanch banane wale karigar tatha dhobi dono uthate the, kyunki kaanch banane me soda kachcha maal hota hai tatha dhobi ise kapde saaf karne me istemal karte hain. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki us daur me bhi log kis tarah apne kshetra ke khanijon ka sidha upyog karte the. Exam point: mitti me ubhre soda ko log khurach kar pani bhare uthle gadhe me daalte the, jisse satah par soda ki parat jam jaati thi; zameen me soda wale hisson me yah parat sabse zyada jama hoti thi tatha wahi se khurachi jaati thi; is soda ka istemal kaanch banane wale karigar tatha dhobi karte the.

qe: On the hill of Tek near Lechuyar in the Gaya tract, what did the surveyor's men bring back from its top besides two kinds of small-grained granite?
qh: गया क्षेत्र में लेछुयार के निकट टेक पहाड़ी की चोटी से सर्वेक्षक के आदमी दो प्रकार के महीन दाने वाले ग्रेनाइट के अलावा और क्या लाए थे?
oe: A strange kind of glassy and brownish quartz
oh: एक अनोखा चमकदार तथा भूरे रंग का क्वार्ट्ज़
e: Gaya kshetra me har pahadi se mile patthar ke namune alag-alag the tatha inke adhyayan se hi is kshetra ki bhu-banawat samajh me aati hai. Lechuyar ke purab ki chhoti pahadiyon se aaye namuno me Tek pahadi ka varnan is tarah milta hai - uske neeche ke hisse me ek anokha chamakdar tatha bhoora kwartj mila, tatha uske top par do tarah ke chhote daane wale granite mile, ek safed jispar gehare hare rang ke chhinte the tatha doosra bhoora. Isi kshetra me Sahinagar naam ki pahadi ka granite ya gneiss bahut hi anokha sidh hua; Satsunda par do tarah ke granite mile, ek bhoora theek-thak tatha doosra peela; Majuya par ek aisa granite mila jispar anokhe dhabbe the; tatha Donayi par safed, neela ya laal rang ka silicayukt hornstone mila, jo kai jagah laal hone ke kaaran dhatu-malbe jaisa lagta tha. Exam point: Tek pahadi ke niche anokha chamakdar bhoora kwartj tatha top par safed tatha bhoora rang ke chhote daane wale granite mile; Sahinagar ka granite ya gneiss bahut anokha bataya gaya; Satsunda par bhoora tatha peela granite, Majuya par dhabbedar granite tatha Donayi par silicayukt hornstone mila.

qe: The hills near which village in the Gaya tract bore an old ruinous mud fort which belonged to the Gidhaur family, the original proprietors of Bishazari?
qh: गया क्षेत्र के किस गाँव के निकट की पहाड़ियों में एक जर्जर पुरानी मिट्टी की गढ़ी थी, जो बिशाज़री के मूल स्वामी गिधौर परिवार की थी?
e: Is pahadi ilake ke gaonon ka itihas bhi bada purana hai tatha wahan ke patthar tatha gadhiyan uske gawah hain. Lechuyar ek theek-thak bada gaon tha, jahan ek purana jarda-jarda makaan tatha ek mitti ki gadhi thi; yah gadhi Gidhaur parivar ki thi, jo Bishazari pargane ke asli swami maane jaate the. Us parivar ka mukhya nivas Lechuyar se purab me Sekunderpur me tha, jahan eenton ka ek kila aaj bhi theek-thak halat me tha tatha us par us Mussalman ke agent ka adhikar tha, jise Bishazari altamgah ke roop me mila tha. Aisi jaankari dikhati hai ki us daur me badi zameenon ka adhikar kaise ek parivar se doosre haathon me jaata tha tatha uske nishan pahadiyon ke paas pade makaan tatha gadhiyon ke roop me bache rahte the. Exam point: Lechuyar gaon me purana jarda-jarda makaan tatha mitti ki gadhi thi, jo Bishazari ke asli swami Gidhaur parivar ki thi; us parivar ka mukhya nivas Lechuyar se purab Sekunderpur me tha, jahan eenton ka kila theek-thak halat me tha; us kile par us Mussalman ke agent ka adhikar tha jise Bishazari altamgah me mila tha.

qe: The town of Sheikhpura, extending more than a mile from east to west, was so narrow that even an elephant could not be squeezed through it; what was the width of the passage between two houses at its west end?
qh: शेखपुरा नगर, जो पूर्व से पश्चिम तक एक मील से अधिक फैला था, इतना संकरा था कि हाथी भी उसमें से निकल नहीं सकता था; उसके पश्चिम छोर पर दो मकानों के बीच का रास्ता कितना चौड़ा था?
e: Sheikhpura ek bada gaon ya chhota nagar tha, jo pas-pas bani imaraton ke saath purv se pashchim tak ek mile se zyada lamba tha, lekin bahut patla tha. Isme ek hi patli gali thi tatha dono taraf kai chhoti-chhoti galiyan khulti thin. Us daur ke ek yatri ke varnan ke mutabik itni tang gali se hathi bhi mushkil se nikal saka, kyunki pashchim chhor par do gharon ke beech ka rasta teen foot se zyada chauda nahi tha; wahan se nikalne ke liye mud ki deewar par chadhna pada. Aisi vyavastha dikhati hai ki nagar ke andar ki galiyan keval paidal chalne ke liye thin, tatha gaadi ya hathi ke liye koi raasta nahi tha. Exam point: Sheikhpura purv se pashchim tak ek mile se adhik lamba par bahut patla nagar tha; iske pashchim chhor par do gharon ke beech ka rasta teen foot se zyada chauda nahi tha, jahan se hathi bhi mushkil se nikal paata tha.

qe: The small range lying west of Sheikhpura consisted of a rude jasper blotched red and white; a little beyond this hill the country became liable to inundation from which small channel flowing in a deep clay soil?
qh: शेखपुरा के पश्चिम में स्थित छोटी पहाड़ी लाल तथा सफ़ेद धब्बों वाले कच्चे जैस्पर की थी; इस पहाड़ी से थोड़ा आगे का क्षेत्र गहरी चिकनी मिट्टी में बहने वाली किस छोटी धारा से जलमग्न होने लगता था?
e: Sheikhpura ke pashchim me pahadi ki ek chhoti shrinkhala thi. Us pahadi ki chattan ek rude jasper thi, yaani kacchi, saaf banawat se rahit jasper, jis par laal tatha safed dhabbe the. Jasper ek kathor siliceous patthar hota hai, yaani aisa patthar jisme silica ki matra zyada hoti hai tatha jo aam taur par laal, peela ya hara hota hai. Is pahadi se thoda aage ka kshetra Tati naam ki ek chhoti dhara se paani se bharne laga tha. Tati gehri chikni mitti me bana ek chhota channel tha, jisme us samay paani khada tha tatha jo pahadi se karib paune ek mile dur tha. Is jal-magn kshetra ka vistaar Tati se pashchim ki or lagbhag do mile tak tha tatha woh bhaag bahut veeran tatha upashashit dikhta tha. Exam point: Sheikhpura ke pashchim ki chhoti pahadi laal-safed dhabbon wali kacchi jasper thi; uske aage ka kshetra Tati naam ki chhoti dhara se paani se bhar jata tha, jiska vistaar pashchim ki or do mile tak tha.

qe: The village of Sawos stands on the north side of a large brick heap, sixty yards from east to west and half as much from north to south, which had no ditch and no hollow on the summit and was therefore called a house or castle rather than a fort; by what name was it known?
qh: सावोस गाँव एक बड़े ईंटों के ढेर के उत्तर की ओर बसा है, जो पूर्व से पश्चिम तक साठ गज़ तथा उत्तर से दक्षिण तक उससे आधा था, और जिसके चारों ओर खाई तथा चोटी पर कोई गड्ढा नहीं था, इसलिए वह किले से अधिक घर या महल जैसा कहा जाता था; वह किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Sawos gaon ek bade eenton ke dher ke uttar ki or basa tha, jisme bahut saari eentein thin tatha jo mukhyatah eenton hi ka bana bataya jaata tha. Yah dher purv se pashchim tak lagbhag saath gaz lamba tatha uttar se dakshin tak usse aadha chauda tha. Iski choti par koi gadha ya khokhla bhaag nahi tha tatha na hi charon or khai ke koi nishan the, isliye yah kila kam, mahal ya kisi bade ghar jaisa lagta tha; phir bhi ise Banwatgori yaani Banwaton ka kila kaha jaata tha. Kaha jaata tha ki Banwat log Goyal the, yaani doodh bechne wale Ahir, jinhone bahut purane samay me is kshetra par adhikar rakha tha. Is dher ke purv chhor par uttar ki or ek bada ubhaar tatha pashchim chhor par eenton ka ek shikharbandh dher tha. Exam point: Sawos ke paas phaile bade eenton ke dher ko Banwatgori yaani Banwaton ka kila kaha jaata tha; khai tatha choti par gadhe ke nishan na hone ke karan woh kila nahi, mahal ya ghar jaisa lagta tha tatha Banwat Goyal bataye jaate the.

qe: At the west end of the big heap at Sawos was a conical heap of bricks with some stones on the summit, said to be the place where the Rajah sat to enjoy the cool of the evening; what did the surveyor think it really was?
qh: सावोस के बड़े ढेर के पश्चिम छोर पर ईंटों का एक शंक्वाकार ढेर था, जिसकी चोटी पर कुछ पत्थर रखे थे; इसे वह स्थान बताया जाता था जहाँ राजा शाम की ठंडक का आनंद लेने बैठता था; सर्वेक्षक का मत था कि यह वास्तव में क्या था?
oe: The ruin of a solid Buddhist temple
oh: बुद्धों के एक ठोस मंदिर का खंडहर
हाथियों के पानी पीने का स्थान
e: Sawos ke bade eenton ke dher ke pashchim chhor par eenton ka ek shikharbandh yaani conical dher tha, jiski choti par kuch patthar rakhe hue the. Gaon ke logon ka kehna tha ki yah woh sthal hai jahan rajya karta tha tatha shaam ki thandak ka aanand lene baithta tha. Lekin is drishya ko dekh kar anuman lagaya gaya ki yah kisi badshah ke baithne ki jagah nahi, balki ek solid yaani thos Bauddh mandir ka khandaar hai. Is anuman ki pushti dher par mile tutey-phutey pattharon se hoti hai, jinme kai muniyon ki murtiyan thin tatha baaki murtiyan Gaya tatha Kewa Dol ke aas-paas milne wali murtiyon jaisee thin. Is tarah eenton ke dher ke neeche chhupe dharmik sthal ke nishan us daur me purane dharm ke khandaaron ka pata dete hain. Exam point: Sawos ke dher ke pashchim chhor wale shikharbandh dher ko logon ne rajya ke baithne ka sthal bataya, lekin uske dher par mili murtiyon ke aadhar par anuman lagaya gaya ki yah ek thos Bauddh mandir ka khandaar tha.

qe: Broken images found under a tree on the big heap at Sawos, several of them of Munis, were said to have been taken from a small temple of which construction?
qh: सावोस के बड़े ढेर पर एक पेड़ के नीचे रखी टूटी-फूटी मूर्तियाँ, जिनमें कई मुनियों की थीं, ऐसे छोटे मंदिर से लाई बताई जाती थीं जो किस तरह बना था?
oe: A brick temple supported by stone pillars
A cave cut into the rock
A stone temple with a brick dome
A wooden shrine on a mound
oh: पत्थर के खंभों पर टिका ईंटों का मंदिर
ईंट के गुंबद वाला पत्थर का मंदिर
टीले पर बनी लकड़ी की देवालय
e: Bade dher ke paas ek ped ke niche tuti-phooti kai murtiyan rakhi thin. Inme kuch Muniyon yaani sadhuon ki murtiyan thi tatha baaki ve murtiyan thin jo Gaya tatha Kewa Dol ke aas-paas aam milti hain, khaas taur par stri tatha bhains ki aakritiyan. Gaon ke logon ke mutabik ye murtiyan ek chhote mandir se laayi gayi thin jo eenton ka bana tatha patthar ke khambon par tika tha. Us mandir ke kuch patthar ke khambon ko nikaal kar paas ki deewar banane me laga diya gaya tha, isliye mandir dheere-dheere tut gaya. Is tarah purani imaraton ke pattharon ka dobara istemal us daur ki aam aadat thi, aur isi karan bahut se dharmik sthal apna asli roop kho baithte the. Exam point: Sawos ke dher par ped ke niche mili murtiyon me Muniyon ki pratimayein thi; ve patthar ke khambon par tike eenton ke ek chhote mandir se laayi gayi thin, jiske khambon ko nikaal kar paas ki deewar me laga diya gaya tha.

qe: Two large images lying in a tank choked with weeds near the Sawos heap were given new names by the people who did not know what they represented; one of them had round its head the figures of several Buddhas. By what names were these two images worshipped?
qh: सावोस के ढेर के पास वनस्पति से भरे तालाब में पड़ी दो बड़ी मूर्तियों को, जिनका वास्तविक अर्थ लोगों को नहीं पता था, नए नाम देकर पूजा जाने लगा; इनमें से एक के सिर के चारों ओर कई बुद्धों की आकृतियाँ बनी थीं। इन दो मूर्तियों की पूजा किन नामों से होने लगी?
e: Sawos ke bade dher ke dakshin me ek talaab tha, jo weeds yaani khar-patar tatha mitti se bhar gaya tha. Us talaab me do badi murtiyan padi thin, jinhe tabahi karne walon ne wahan phenk diya tha. Baad me kuch murtiyan yahin ke khandaaron se nikaal kar phir puja ki vastu ban gayin, lekin logo ko yah pata nahi tha ki unme kya dikhaya gaya hai, isliye unhone unhe naye naam de diye. Talaab wali murtiyan asal me Muniyon ki thin, lekin unhe Bhairab tatha Lakshmi Narayan ke naam se pukara jaane laga; unme keval ek hi purush roop tha, phir bhi dono naam chalte rahe. Inme se jo Bhairab kahlati thi, uske sir ke charon or kai Buddha ke chhote-chhote chihn bane hue the. Exam point: Sawos ke talaab me padi do badi murtiyon ko log Bhairab tatha Lakshmi Narayan ke naam se pujne lage, kyunki unhe unka asli arth nahi pata tha; ek murti ke sir ke charon or kai Buddha ke chihn the, jo unke Bauddh mool ka pata dete hain.

qe: About a mile and a half west of the Sakri channel stood a large reservoir made partly by digging and partly by a bank to confine the water of a canal; what were its dimensions?
qh: सकरी धारा से लगभग डेढ़ मील पश्चिम में एक बड़ा जलाशय था, जो आधा खोदाई से तथा आधा नहर का पानी रोकने वाले बाँध से बनाया गया था; उसका विस्तार कितना था?
e: Sakri dhara se karib dedh mile pashchim me ek bada talaab ya jalashay tha. Yah jalashay poora khod kar nahi, balki aadha khodai se tatha aadha ek bandh yaani bankh se banaya gaya tha, jiska kaam ek canal se aane wale paani ko rokna tha. Uska vistaar lagbhag 300 gaz chauda tatha 600 gaz lamba tha, isliye woh apne samay ka ek bada jalashay maana gaya. Paani rokne ke is tareeke se wahan paani khada rahta tha tatha khar-patar kam ugte the, isliye woh dekne me ek saaf tatha suhavana talaab lagta tha tatha usme char-pakshi bhi aate the. Aise jalashay sinchai tatha rozana ke istemal ke liye us daur me bahut mahatvapurn the. Exam point: Sakri dhara se dedh mile pashchim ka jalashay aadha khodai tatha aadha bandh se banaya gaya tha; uska vistaar lagbhag 300 gaz chauda tatha 600 gaz lamba tha tatha woh paani rokne ke liye ek canal se juda tha.

qe: The route from the west end of Sheikhpura towards the next chief town, though it was the line of communication between two of the chief towns of the district, was found to be what?
qh: शेखपुरा के पश्चिम छोर से अगले प्रमुख नगर की ओर का मार्ग, जो जिले के दो प्रमुख नगरों के बीच संचार की मुख्य रेखा था, वास्तव में कैसा पाया गया?
oe: A minor canal with a towpath
Only a footpath, and that not much frequented
oh: किनारे की पगडंडी वाली छोटी नहर
केवल एक पगडंडी, वह भी बहुत कम आने-जाने वाली
e: Sheikhpura se pashchim ki or jaane wale raste ke baare me jaan-kar logon ne bataya tha ki woh bahut achha hai, lekin kuch dur chalne par saaf ho gaya ki wahan koi bani hui sadak nahi thi - keval ek pagdandi thi, woh bhi bahut kam istemal hoti thi. Hairani ki baat yah thi ki yah pagdandi hi jile ke do pramukh nagaron ke beech aane-jaane ki mukhya rekha thi, isliye yah apne aap me us daur ki sadak-vyavastha ki halat batati hai. Aage ke raste me bade-bade gaon aaye, lekin unke ghar itne chipke hue the ki bailgadi ya hathi ke nikalne ki jagah hi nahi bachi thi; raste bhi zyadatar khali bhoomi, khet ya nadi-nale ke kinare se hote the. Exam point: Sheikhpura se pashchim ka marg, jo jile ke do pramukh nagaron ke beech ki mukhya rekha tha, keval ek kam-prayog hone wali pagdandi tha; raaste ke gaonon ke ghar itne chipke the ki bailgadi ya hathi nahi nikal sakta tha.

qe: The hill at Behar consists of granular quartz or silicious hornstone, in most places white or grey but in others stained red; in what manner is the rock disposed?
qh: बिहार की पहाड़ी दानेदार क्वार्ट्ज़ या सिलिसियस हॉर्नस्टोन की बनी है, जो अधिकतर स्थानों पर सफ़ेद या भूरे रंग की है तथा कहीं-कहीं लाल रंग में रंगी है; चट्टान किस रूप में जमी हुई है?
oe: In parallel layers rising from east to west at about 26 degrees
In flat horizontal beds with no tilt
oh: पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर लगभग 26 अंश के कोण पर उठी समानांतर परतों में
बिना झुकाव की सपाट क्षैतिज परतों में
गोल पत्थरों के ढेर के रूप में
e: Behar ki pahadi ek bahut hi nangi chattan wali pahadi hai; yah uttar-dakshin me faili hui hai, iska pashchim ki or ka dhala bahut tez hai tatha purv ki or halka hai. Pahadi ki chattan dane wale quartz ya silicious hornstone ki bani hai, jo adhiktar sthanon par safed ya bhuri hai tatha kuch jagah laal rang me rangi hui hai. Yah chattan samanantar paraton me jami hui hai, jo purv se pashchim ki or lagbhag 26 degree ke kon par uthti hain; in paraton ki motai aadhe foot se do foot tak hoti hai, isliye inhe kshitij ke saman strata yaani satah bhi maana ja sakta hai. Anuman lagaya gaya ki ye satahein thandak, sookhne ya sadan ke karan bani dararon se bani hain. Exam point: Behar ki pahadi ki chattan dane wale quartz ya silicious hornstone ki hai, jo purv se pashchim ki or lagbhag 26 degree ke kon par uthi samanantar paraton me jami hui hai; paraton ki motai aadhe se do foot tak hai.

qe: The rock of the hill at Behar is intersected by vertical fissures running east and west and north and south; the east-west fissures had become very wide, often several feet, apparently owing to the action of what?
qh: बिहार की पहाड़ी की चट्टान पूर्व-पश्चिम तथा उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशाओं में जाने वाली ऊर्ध्वाधर दरारों से कटी हुई है; पूर्व-पश्चिम की दरारें बहुत चौड़ी, अक्सर कई फुट तक हो गई थीं, जिसका कारण क्या माना गया?
oe: Rain running down the declivity of the hill
oh: पहाड़ी की ढलान पर बहता वर्षा का पानी
e: Behar ki pahadi ki chattan me do tarah ki khadi dararein (fissures) dekhi gayin - ek jo purv-pashchim ki or jaati thi tatha doosri jo uttar-dakshin ki or. Uttar-dakshin wali dararein keval patli darar jaisi hi rahi, lekin purv-pashchim wali dararein bahut chaudi ho gayi thi, jo aksar kai foot chaudi thi. Iska kaaran pahadi ki dhalan par bahta varsha ka paani maana gaya, jo baar-baar in dararon me se beh kar unhe chauda karta raha. Chunki pahadi ka pashchim ki or ka dhala bahut tez hai, isliye wahan paani ka bahav aur tez hota tha. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki chattan ka roop sirf uski banti se nahi, balki mausam tatha paani ke lambe samay ke asar se bhi banta hai. Exam point: Behar ki pahadi ki purv-pashchim wali khadi dararein kai foot chaudi ho gayi thin, jiska kaaran pahadi ki dhalan par bahta varsha ka paani maana gaya; uttar-dakshin wali dararein keval patli hi rahi.

qe: The great elevation at Giriak, consisting of broken bricks, rude masses of stone and earth, was believed to have been a great castle or palace; what was the elevation of its northern part?
qh: गिरियक के उस विशाल टीले के बारे में, जो टूटी ईंटों, पत्थर के कच्चे टुकड़ों तथा मिट्टी से बना था, माना गया कि वह कोई बड़ा दुर्ग या महल रहा होगा; उसके उत्तरी भाग की ऊँचाई कितनी थी?
oh: लंबवत् रूप से 8 फुट से कम नहीं
लंबवत् रूप से 150 फुट से कम नहीं
लंबवत् रूप से 80 फुट से कम नहीं
लंबवत् रूप से 30 फुट से कम नहीं
e: Giriak gaon punchanan nadi ke paas ek unchi jagah par basa tha, jahan bahut si eentein bikhri thi. Gaon ke turant dakshin me ek talaab tha jo bahut bhar gaya tha, tatha uske aage aur dakshin-pashchim me anya talaab the. In talaabon tatha Panchanan nadi ke kinare-kinare ek bahut bada teela tha, jo tooti eenton, doosri or ki pahadi se laye gaye patthar ke kacche tukdon tatha mitti se bana tha. Yah kudrat ka teela nahi tha, kyunki is kshetra ki pahadiyan keval chattan hoti hain tatha unme mitti bahut kam hoti hai; teele ki shakal me samanta ke chinh bhi the. Uska uttari bhaag lambvat roop se 80 foot se kam nahi tha tatha uske andar koi khaali jagah nazar nahi aati thi; isliye anuman lagaya gaya ki yah karya kisi bade durg ya mahal ka raha hoga. Exam point: Giriak ke teele ke uttari bhaag ki unchai lambvat roop se 80 foot se kam nahi thi tatha uske andar koi khaali jagah nahi thi; isliye usse bada durg ya mahal maana gaya.

qe: On the top of the great heap at Giriak had been erected a small square fort with a ditch, whose rampart and bastions had been faced with bricks taken probably from where?
qh: गिरियक के बड़े टीले के शिखर पर खाई वाला एक छोटा वर्गाकार किला बना था, जिसकी प्राचीर तथा बुर्ज कहाँ से ली गई ईंटों से मढ़े गए थे?
oe: From the banks of the Panchanan river
From the ancient ruin on the heap itself
oh: उसी टीले के प्राचीन खंडहर से
e: Giriak ke bade teele par eenton tatha pattharon ka dher tha, jise do bhaagon me baanta ja sakta tha; dakshin wala bhaag kaafi neecha tha tatha dono bhaagon me purb tatha pashchim ki or projection yaani baramde ya dwar jaise bane the. Teele ke shikhar par ek chhota vargakar kila bana tha, jiske charon or khai khodi gayi thi; iski prachir tatha buruj un eenton se madhe gaye the, jo sambhavtah usi purane khandhar se li gayi thi. Kile ki khai ko dekh kar pata chalta hai ki woh khandhar ke dher ko khod kar hi banayi gayi thi; isliye yah maanna theek nahi tha ki teela tatha kila ek hi samay me bane. Exam point: Giriak ke badhe teele ke shikhar par bana chhota vargakar kila khai se ghira tha tatha uski prachir-buruj purane khandhar ki eenton se madhe gaye the; khai teele ko khod kar banayi gayi thi.

qe: The large heap at Giriak was evidently what the people of Nawada called it, though the people on the spot had no such tradition?
qh: गिरियक का बड़ा टीला स्पष्टतः वही था जिसे नवादा के लोग कहते थे, हालाँकि आस-पास के लोगों में ऐसी कोई परंपरा नहीं थी?
e: Nawada ke log is bade teele ko Jarasandha ka ghar kehte the, lekin sthal ke logon me aisi koi parampara nahi thi. Giriak naam ki pahadi par Jarasandha se judi imaratein batayi jaati hain, jo us gaon ke bilkul samne hai. Jarasandha ko yahan ek Asur ya Daitya maana gaya, jo itna vishal tha ki ek pair Giriak par tatha doosra teen koses door Rajgir par rakh kar chal sakta tha tatha Dwarka ke samundar tak eentein phenk sakta tha. Kaha jaata hai ki isi shararat se Dwarka me rehne wale devta ki 16,000 patniyan pareshan huin; isliye ve devta yahan Jarasandha se yuddh karne aaye tatha Pandu ke putra Bhima ke haath se uski hatya karayi. Exam point: Giriak ke bade teele ko Nawada ke log Jarasandha ka ghar kehte the; Jarasandha ko itna vishal Asur maana gaya ki woh ek pair Giriak aur doosra Rajgir par rakh kar Dwarka tak eentein phenk sakta tha tatha Bhima ke haath se mara gaya.

qe: A tradition heard at Patna placed the Hangsa Rajah, said by a local ascetic to have built the place whose old name was Haugsa Nagar, at which place?
qh: पटना में सुनी गई एक परंपरा के अनुसार हंस राजा, जिसके बारे में एक स्थानीय संन्यासी कहता था कि उसने पुराने 'हौंसा नगर' नामक स्थान को बसाया, कहाँ रहता था?
e: Giriak ke teele ke baare me sthal ke samajhdar logon ki koi parampara nahi thi; kuch log maante the ki woh kile ke saath hi bana, jo galat hai, kyunki kile ki khai teele ke khandhar ko khod kar banayi gayi thi. Ek Dasnami sanyasi dava karta tha ki sthal ka purana naam Haugsa Nagar hai tatha ise Hangsa Rajah ne basaya tha; lekin kisi anya vyakti ne aisi parampara suni nahi thi. Patna me suni gayi parampara ke mutabik Hangsa Rajah Phulwari me rehta tha. Aise ulajhe paramparaon ka milna dikhata hai ki purane sthalon ke itihas ke baare me prachin samay se hi kai alag-alag kahaniyan prachalit ho gayi thi. Exam point: Patna me mili parampara ke mutabik Hangsa Rajah Phulwari me rehta tha; ek sthaniya sanyasi ke dava ke mutabik sthal ka purana naam Haugsa Nagar tha, lekin iski pushti kisi anya se nahi hui thi.

qe: Krishna gave orders that people should bathe in the Panchanan at Giriak, and how many persons are said to assemble for the purpose in the month of Kartik?
qh: कृष्ण ने आदेश दिया था कि लोग गिरियक की पंचानन नदी में स्नान करें; कार्तिक महीने में इस उद्देश्य से कितने लोगों के इकट्ठा होने की बात कही जाती है?
e: Jarasandha se judi parampara ke mutabik Krishna ne aadesh diya tha ki log Panchanan nadi me snan karen, tatha Kartik mahine me is uddeshya se 50,000 logon ke ikatthe hone ki baat kahi jaati hai. Yah parampara dikhati hai ki nadion tatha ghation ke snan se jude melon tatha tirth-yatra ki prachin parampara ka itihas kitna purana hai tatha woh sthal-vishisht lok-kathaon se kaise juda hota hai. Panchanan nadi Giriak ke paas bahti thi, tatha garmi ke mausam me usme paani bahut kam reh jaata tha; varsha me yah kinare tak bhar jaati thi. Giriak ke teele, kile tatha murtiyon ke aas-paas bane talaab bhi is sthal ki prachin lok-smriti ke ang the. Exam point: Panchanan nadi me snan karne tatha Kartik me 50,000 logon ke ikatthe hone ki parampara Jarasandha se judi katha se nikalti hai; yah sthal Giriak ke paas sthit hai.

qe: Which substance, issuing from a crevice in the quartz about thirty feet above a cave, was collected by an old Musaliar who fortified himself with liquor and made oblation to the ghosts of the saints, bringing back about an ounce measure in a leaf?
qh: एक गुफा से क़रीब तीस फुट ऊपर क्वार्ट्ज़ की दरार से निकलने वाला कौन-सा पदार्थ एक वृद्ध मुसलियार (मुसलमान साधक) द्वारा एकत्र किया जाता था, जो शराब पीकर बल पाता और संतों की आत्माओं को भेंट चढ़ाकर एक पत्ते में लगभग एक औंस भर लाया?
e: Us kshetra ki ek pahadi me ek badi gufa hai, jiske upar ki chattan me ek darar se ek pavitra maana jaane wala padarth nikalta hai, jise silajit kaha jaata hai. Is sthal ke logon ka vishwas tha ki yah padarth sirf kisi vishesh vidhi se hi liya ja sakta hai; isliye ek vriddh Musaliar yaani Muslim sadhak sharab peekar bal paakar tatha santon ki aatmaon ko bhaint chadha kar chattan par pahuncha tatha ek patte me lagbhag ek ounce bhar silajit lekar aaya. Yah padarth naye shehad jaisa gaadha, lekin usse patla hota hai; uspar dhool tatha malba jam jata hai, uski rangat maili matti jaisi hoti hai tatha gandh tej hoti hai. Aisa varnan dikhata hai ki us samay patthar se nikalne wale khaniy padarthon ka upyog dawa ke roop me hota tha. Exam point: Chattan ki darar se nikalne wala silajit ek vriddh Musaliar ne ek patte me lagbhag ek ounce bhar kar liya; yah naye shehad jaisa gaadha tatha maili rang ka padarth tha, jise dawa ke roop me upyogi maana jaata tha.

qe: Which Patna resident owned the place from which the Silajit was collected near Hariya, the whole season's collection being said not to exceed a seer?
qh: हरिया के पास जहाँ से सिलाजित एकत्र होता था, वह स्थान पटना के किस व्यक्ति का था, जहाँ एक मौसम के कुल संग्रह के एक सेर से अधिक न होने की बात कही जाती थी?
e: Hariya ke paas jis sthal se silajit nikalta tha, woh Patna ke Unj Kogal Singh ka tha tatha jo bhi silajit wahan ikattha hota, woh usi ko bheja jaata tha. Wahan ke log batate the ki woh vriddh Musaliar Paush tatha Magh mahinon me lagbhag teen din tak jata hai tatha usse ek din me ek ya do sicca weight se adhik silajit nahi milta; poore mausam me usse jo kuch milta hai, woh ek seer se adhik nahi hota. Yah baat sandeh ke saath kahi jaati thi, kyunki dekhne me lagta tha ki kuch parishram se aaj hi do ounce se adhik ikattha ho sakta tha. Ek hi sthal ke bahar, karib paav bhar purab me, isi tarah silajit nikalne ki doosri jagah bhi thi. Exam point: Silajit wale sthal ke maalik Patna ke Unj Kogal Singh the tatha unhi ko sab silajit bheja jaata tha; Paush tatha Magh me din ke ek-do sicca weight ke hisab se poore mausam ka sangrah ek seer se adhik na hone ki baat kahi jaati thi.

qe: In the surveyor's comparison of the two rocks, the hills of which rock were inferior in grandeur to those of granite, though they produced more springs and little rivulets?
qh: सर्वेक्षक की दो चट्टानों की तुलना में, किस पत्थर की पहाड़ियाँ ग्रेनाइट की पहाड़ियों से कम भव्य थीं, फिर भी उनसे अधिक झरने तथा छोटी धाराएँ निकलती थीं?
e: Pattharon ke tulnatmak adhyayan se pata chalta hai ki quartz yaani sphatik jaisi safed chattan ki pahadiyan tatha granite ki pahadiyan alag-alag prakriti ki hoti hain. Granite ki pahadiyan sabse oonchi tatha sabse bhavya chotiyon ke roop me uthti hain tatha unki darar tatha chhedon me paudhe-podhe achhi tarah uge hain; iske vipreet quartz ki pahadiyan unse kam unchi tatha kam bhavya lagti hain. Lekin quartz ki pahadiyon se zyada jharne tatha chhoti dharaayein nikalte hain tatha unki kundiyon tatha dhalon me ekdum khadi tatha aashcharyajanak sundar dikhne wali chattanein banti hain. Kuch sthalon par quartz ki chattan safed hai, kuch par raakh jaisi tatha kuch jagah laal dikhti hai; yah chattan horizontal tatha vertical dararon dwara rhombus yaani hira jaisi aakar wale tukdon me bati hoti hai. Exam point: Quartz ki pahadiyan granite ki tulna me kam bhavya hoti hain, lekin unse adhik jharne tatha chhoti dharaayein nikalte hain; quartz ki chattan safed, raakh jaisi ya laal ho sakti hai tatha horizontal tatha vertical dararon se usme hira jaisi aakar wale tukde ban jaate hain.

qe: Which rock, consisting of a red rude jasper with veins of white quartz, formed the little conical hill named Konva, to which masses of a fine white substance, half crystallized, were found adhering?
qh: लाल रंग का कच्चा जैस्पर, जिसमें सफ़ेद क्वार्ट्ज़ की नसें थीं, किस छोटी शंक्वाकार पहाड़ी का निर्माण करता था, जिससे आधे-क्रिस्टलीय सफ़ेद पदार्थ के पिंड चिपके पाए गए?
e: Us kshetra me pattharon ki kataar kam nahi thi. Konva naam ki ek chhoti shankvakar pahadi laal rang ke kacche jasper se bani thi, jisme safed quartz yaani sphatik ki nasen thin; isi patthar se jude aadhe crystallized yaani kristal ban chuke ek mahin safed padarth ke pind bhi milte the, jinke bare me nishchay nahi ho paata tha ki woh quartz hain ya felspar. Jasper ek kathor patthar hota hai, jo quartz jaise padarth ka mahin aur gaadha roop hota hai; us kshetra ki pahadiyon ka patthar isi tarah safed, bhoora tatha laal rangon me milta tha, jise polish dene par achha asar aata. Patthar ke aise varnan se un ilaqon ki bhugarbhiya sanrachna samajhne me madad milti hai. Exam point: Konva ki chhoti shankvakar pahadi laal kacche jasper se bani thi, jisme safed quartz ki nasen thin tatha usse aadhe kristal ban chuke mahin safed padarth ke pind jude paae gaye; jasper quartz jaisa kathor patthar hota hai.

qe: A little south of Amaiti, what was seen efflorescing on the surface of a small barren space, the ridge behind consisting of an exceedingly hard granular rude jasper?
qh: अमैती से थोड़ा दक्षिण में, एक छोटे बंजर स्थान की सतह पर क्या उभरती (efloresce) दिखी, जबकि पीछे की श्रेणी अत्यंत कठोर तथा दानेदार कच्चे जैस्पर की थी?
e: Sarvekshak Amaiti ke aas-paas ke kshetra ka bhi nirikshan kar raha tha. Amaiti se thoda dakshin me ek chhote banzar hisse ki satah par soda ubar kar khula hua dikha. Effloresce ka arth hai kisi satah par namak ya khaniy padarth ka safed churn ya kuchak ke roop me ubharna, jo tayaab me paani ke vaansh tatha sukhne se hota hai. Soda yaani sodium carbonate ko us samay safai tatha anya kaam ke liye tatha sheesha banane me upyog kiya jaata tha. Us kshetra ki shreniyon ke bane hone ki sanrachna bhi bahut dhyan khinchne wali thi - inme ek atyant kathor tatha dane shreni bhi shamil thi, jise kaccha jasper kaha gaya tatha jiske bhi kai rang dikhe. Exam point: Amaiti se dakshin ke ek chhote banzar sthal ki satah par soda ubar kar khula hua dikha; efflorescence paani ke vaansh se satah par churn ke roop me ubharna hota hai tatha soda safai aur sheeshe ke kaam aane wala padarth hai.

qe: In the two middle kunds the heat was 100.5 and 102 degrees and small fishes and many frogs lived in them, while in the two extreme ponds the heat was 112 and 110 degrees; what did the surveyor conclude from this?
qh: बीच के दो कुंडों में तापमान 100.5 तथा 102 डिग्री था तथा उनमें छोटी मछलियाँ तथा बहुत से मेंढक रहते थे, जबकि दोनों छोर के तालाबों का तापमान 112 तथा 110 डिग्री था; सर्वेक्षक ने इससे क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला?
oe: That this points out the heat in which these animals can live with comfort
That the water of the extreme ponds was unfit only for bathing
That the middle kunds were dry for most of the year
That fishes and frogs prefer the hottest water
oh: यह दर्शाता है कि इन जीवों के आराम से रहने योग्य ताप कितना होता है
छोर के तालाबों का पानी केवल स्नान के लिए अनुपयुक्त था
बीच के कुंड वर्ष के अधिकांश समय सूखे रहते थे
मछलियाँ तथा मेंढक सबसे गर्म पानी पसंद करते हैं
e: Tapaban tatha Rajgir ke aas-paas srot yaani spring wale kai kund the. In talabon me se kuch eenton se astar yaani lined the tatha sabhi theek-thak marammat ki halat me the; inme se kisi me bhi Bhagalpur jile ke kundon jaisa hawa ke bulb ke roop me vayu nikalta hua nahi dikha, keval aakhri kund me bahut kam matra me. Sarvekshak ne dekha ki beech ke do kundon me, jinka taap 100.5 tatha 102 degrees tha, kuch chhoti machhaliyan tatha bahut se mendhak rahte the; lekin dono chhor ke kundon me (112 tatha 110 degrees) yeh jeev nahi rah sakte the, kyunki ve wahan dikhe hi nahi. Isse nishkarsh nikla ki yeh isi tapmaan ka sanket tha, jisme aise jeev aaram se rah sakte hain; us samay yeh talab snan tatha dharmik kaam ke liye bhi prayog hote the. Exam point: beech ke kundon me (100.5 tatha 102 degrees) chhoti machhaliyan tatha mendhak rahte the, jabki chhor ke kundon me (112 tatha 110 degrees) ve nahi rah sakte the; isse pata chalta hai ki in jeevon ke aaram se rahne ke liye tapmaan ki seema kya hai.

qe: Between two ridges near Narawat a reservoir had been formed by a bank about half a mile in length drawn across a wide gap; what was the bank made of?
qh: नरावत के पास दो श्रेणियों के बीच एक चौड़ी दरार पर करीब आधा मील लंबा बाँध बनाकर जलाशय तैयार किया गया था; वह बाँध किस चीज़ का बना था?
e: Narawat tatha uske aas-paas ke kshetra me jal-sanrakshan ki ek vyavastha bhi dikhi. Do shreniyan yaani ridge ke beech ek chaudi darar dikhi, jiske niche ek sundar maidan tha, jiska bada hissa varsha ritu me paani se bhar jaata tha; yah vyavastha darar par karib aadhe mile lamba patan yaani bank banakar ki gayi thi tatha yah bank keval mitti ka bana tha, kisi eent ya patthar ka nahi. Shreni yahan se thodi aage dakshin tak chal kar do chhoti pahadiyon me khatam ho jaati hai. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki us ilaqe ke log varsha ke paani ko rok kar kheti tatha anya kaam ke liye kaise istemal karte the. Exam point: Narawat ke paas do shreniyon ke beech ki chaudi darar par karib aadhe mile lamba bank banakar jalaashay taiyar kiya gaya tha tatha yah bank keval mitti ka bana tha; baaki shreni do chhoti pahadiyon me simat jaati thi.

qe: At the small hummock near Kharivart, from which its name is derived, which mineral was being wrought, its rock being a kind of intermixture of imperfect reddle and hornstone or quartz?
qh: खरिवर्त के पास की उस छोटी पहाड़ी पर, जिससे इसका नाम बना है, कौन-सा खनिज निकाला जा रहा था, जिसकी चट्टान अधूरे लाल गेरू (रेडल) तथा हॉर्नस्टोन या क्वार्ट्ज़ का मिश्रण थी?
e: Us kshetra me pattharon tatha khanij padarthon ka bhi vistrit varnan milta hai. Khori naam ka ek lal rang ka khanij padarth Kharivart ke paas ki chhoti gol pahadi me nikalta tha, jisse is jagah ka naam hi pad gaya. Us pahadi ki chattan adhure reddle yaani lal gairu tatha hornstone ya quartz ke mishran jaisi thi; kuch jagah usme khori ke tukde dhase hue the tatha kuch jagah chattan peeli bhi dikhti thi. Khori ko do jagah se nikala jaata tha, lekin bade paimane par nahi. Pahadi ke niche ke hisse me khori ek aniyamit nest yaani jeb jaisi jagah me milti thi, jiske aas-paas adhura reddle tha, jo apni prakriti me khori ke kareeb tha; isi karan sthal ke logon ka kehna tha ki khori asal me reddle hi hai, jo bigad kar ya saaf hokar khori ban gayi. Exam point: Kharivart ke paas ki pahadi se khori naam ka lal khanij nikalta tha, jiski chattan adhure reddle tatha hornstone ya quartz ka mishran thi; sthal ke logon ka manna tha ki khori reddle ka hi bigda ya saaf hua roop hai.

qe: The workmen at the Khori mine first dug a narrow gallery into the mineral until they were stopped by what, after which they began beating pieces from the sides and the roof?
qh: खोरी की खदान के मज़दूरों ने पहले खनिज में एक संकरी गैलरी खोदी, जो उन्हें किस चीज़ ने रोक दिया, जिसके बाद उन्होंने किनारों तथा छत से टुकड़े कूटने शुरू किए?
e: Khori nikalne ka tareeqa bahut hi saral tatha kam sudh tha. Khadanki mazdoor pehle khori me ek sankri gallery yaani surang khodte the tatha jab ve paani tak pahunch jaate the, to ruk jaate the; uske baad ve kinaron tatha chhat se tukde kutne lagte the. Is karan khori ka har tukda neeche girti thi tatha niche se bahut mushkil se upar laayi jaati thi; aakhir me seedhiyon ki zaroorat padne lagi. Ek hi khori me rang ke halke-halke antar wali kai paraon me padti thi, isliye uski satah khurdari yaani khurduri thi. Doosri vein ki khori safed tatha bahut khurdari thi tatha usme quartz ke badle hue tukde milte the; yah vein bahut upri thi tatha abhi shuru hi hui thi, isliye aasha thi ki andar jaakar woh behtar hogi. Exam point: Khori ki khan me pehle sankri gallery khodi jaati thi tatha paani aane par kaam ruk jaata tha; uske baad kinaron aur chhat se tukde koote jaate the tatha unhe ladders ki madad se upar laana padta tha, jis se nikalne ka tareeqa bahut mushkil tatha saral tha.

qe: Khori dug at Saren was used for what purpose, while the indurated reddle found there was inferior in quality to that brought from Gwalior and used by the Sannyasis for dyeing their clothes?
qh: सरेन में निकाली जाने वाली खोरी किस काम आती थी, जबकि वहाँ मिलने वाला कड़ा किया हुआ रेडल ग्वालियर से आने वाले तथा संन्यासियों द्वारा कपड़े रंगने में प्रयुक्त रेडल से घटिया था?
oh: बच्चों को लिखना सिखाने के लिए
e: Saren ki pahadi par tarah-tarah ke patthar mile, jo sabhi purab-pashchim lambaai me khade tukdon me toot-te the. Wahan khori kam-zyada saaf halat me milti thi, jise kuch jagah to bachchon ko likhna sikhane ke liye nikala jaata tha - yani us par likh kar abhyas kiya jaata tha. Sath hi kadha yaani indurated reddle bhi aam milta tha, lekin uski gunvatta Gwalior se aane wale reddle se bahut kam thi; Gwalior wale reddle ko Sannyasi yaani sanyasi log apne kapdon ko rangne me upyog karte the. Saren ki pahadi ke uttar ki or ka bada patthar ka dher, khaasakar uske pashchim sire ki choti, ek slag yaani dhatu pighalne par bache kachre jaisa padarth lagta tha, jisme bahut loha tatha kai jagah quartz tatha khori ke nodule the. Exam point: Saren me khori ko kuch jagah bachchon ko likhna sikhane ke liye nikala jaata tha, jabki wahan ka kadha reddle Gwalior ke reddle se ghatiya tha, jise Sannyasi kapde rangne me upyog karte the.

qe: Which small hummock near Majholi consisted of material in a great state of decay and becoming schistose, and was considered an intermediate state between rude jasper and Khori?
qh: मझोली के पास की कौन-सी छोटी पहाड़ी ऐसी चट्टान से बनी थी जो बहुत अधिक क्षय (decay) की अवस्था में थी तथा शिस्ट जैसी बनती जा रही थी, और जिसे कच्चे जैस्पर तथा खोरी के बीच की मध्यावस्था माना गया?
oe: The hummock at the village of Majholi
e: Kharivart ki pahadi se aage lagbhag ek mile door Majholi gaon ki ek doosri chhoti pahadi mili, jo milti-julti chattan se bani thi, lekin bahut zyada gal-chuki haalat me thi tatha schist yaani patli-patli paraon wala patthar ban rahi thi. Isi karan vivran-karta ne ise kacche jasper tatha khori ke beech ki madhyaavastha maana; is padarth ka koi saaf roop abhi wahan nahi mila tha. Aage karib paao bhar door ek teesri chhoti pahadi bhi thi, jahan pehle khori khodi jaati thi, lekin ab woh vein khatam ho chuki thi. Us pahadi ki chattan khay mein khadi patli paraon me bant rahi thi, jo purab-uttar-purab tatha pashchim-dakshin-pashchim disha me jaati thin; wahi vein pahadi ki poori lambaai me isi disha me chali gayi thi tatha lagbhag chaar foot chaudi tatha itni hi gehri tak khodi gayi thi. Exam point: Majholi gaon ki chhoti pahadi bahut ksheen avastha me thi tatha schist jaisi ban rahi thi, isliye use kacche jasper tatha khori ke beech ki madhyaavastha maana gaya; uske paas ki teesri pahadi ki khori ki vein khatam ho chuki thi.

qe: The great mass of rock on the north side of the hill at Saren, containing much iron and in many parts nodules of quartz and Khori, appeared to the surveyor to be what?
qh: सरेन की पहाड़ी के उत्तर की ओर का वह बड़ा शैल-पिंड, जिसमें बहुत लोहा तथा कई जगह क्वार्ट्ज़ और खोरी के नोड्यूल थे, सर्वेक्षक को क्या प्रतीत हुआ?
e: Saren ki pahadi, jo is chhoti shreni ki sabse badi pahadi thi, kai tarah ke pattharon se bani thi tatha sabhi patthar purab-pashchim lambaai me khade tukdon me toot rahe the. Iske uttar ki or ka bada patthar ka bher, khaaskar pashchim choti ki or, vivran-karta ko saaf taur par slag lagta tha; slag woh kachra jaisa padarth hota hai, jo dhatu ko pighlane par bach jaata hai tatha jisme loha jaise dhatu tatha kachre ke tukde milte hain. Us bher me bahut loha tha, kuch hissa laal tatha kuch kaala, aur kai jagah quartz tatha khori ke chhote-chhote nodule yaani ganth the. Iske vipreet pahadi ke dakshin hisse me hornstone tha, jisme loha bhar gaya tha tatha jo ek lahar-daar yaani lehradaar paraon me bana tha, jinki rangein alag-alag thin; yah dikhne me khori jaisa lagta tha, lekin bahut kathor tha tatha slag jaisa nahi dikhta tha. Exam point: Saren ki pahadi ke uttar ka bada shail-pind sarvsadharan taur par slag lagta tha, jisme bahut loha tatha quartz aur khori ke nodule the; dakshin hisse me alag-alag rangon ki lehradaar paraon wala loha-mishrit hornstone mila, jo bahut kathor tha tatha slag jaisa nahi tha.

qe: Dukrighat, a pass over a corner of a large mass of hills, fills up the space between the great quartzose range of which place and the granite range of detached peaks extending east from Patalkati?
qh: डुकरीघाट, जो पहाड़ियों के एक बड़े समूह के कोने पर का दर्रा है, किस स्थान की विशाल क्वार्ट्ज़मय श्रेणी तथा पटलकटी से पूर्व की ओर फैली अलग-अलग चोटियों की ग्रेनाइट श्रेणी के बीच का भाग भरता है?
e: Dukrighat ek darra tha, jo pahadiyon ke ek bade samuh ke kone par se jaata tha tatha jise khori wali pahadiyon ki shreni ka ek hissa ya uska mukhya bhaag maana ja sakta tha. Yah darra Rajagriho yaani Rajgir ki vishal quartz-may shreni tatha Patalkati yaani Kunbur se purab ki or faili granit shreni ki alag-alag chotiyon ke beech ka bhaag bharta tha. Us granit shreni ki sabse purabi choti ka granit bahut hi saaf tatha chhote dane wala tha, jisme safed felspar, quartz tatha kala abhrak milta tha; Dukrighat khud alag-alag patli paraon wale bahut hi kathor hornstone se bana tha. Vivran-karta ne pehle doosre raste se jaane ki koshish ki thi, lekin do mile chalne ke baad rasta deemak nahi nikla, isliye usse wapas hokar Dukrighat se jaana pada. Exam point: Dukrighat ka darra Rajagriho (Rajgir) ki quartz-may shreni tatha Patalkati se purab ki granit shreni ki chotiyon ke beech ka bhaag bharta tha; us shreni ki sabse purabi choti ka granit safed felspar, quartz tatha kale abhrak wala badiya granit tha tatha darra kathor hornstone ka bana tha.

qe: At the foot of the hill near Tomaghat was found an unctuous yellow clay called Fila mati; how did the potters separate the fragments of rock mixed with it?
qh: तोमाघाट के पास पहाड़ी के नीचे 'फ़ीला माटी' नाम की चिकनी पीली मिट्टी मिली; उसमें मिले पत्थर के टुकड़ों को कुम्हार कैसे अलग करते थे?
oe: By throwing the whole into water and collecting the lighter sediment
oh: पूरी मिट्टी को पानी में डालकर हल्की तलछट इकट्ठी करके
e: Dukrighat ke raste par pahadi ke nichle hisse me ek unctuous yaani chikni, tel jaisi peeli mitti mili, jise Fila mati kaha jaata tha - yah naam uske rang ke karan pada. Yah mitti kumharon ke kaam aati thi, lekin iski matra bahut kam thi, yah poori tarah upri satah par thi tatha usme patthar ke bahut se tukde mile hue the. Kumhar in patthar ke tukdon ko alag karne ke liye poori mitti ko paani me daalte the; isse bhaari patthar ke tukde niche baith jaate the tatha halki mitti ka sediment yaani talchh pani me upar ya alag ho jaata tha, jise ikattha kar liya jaata tha. Usi ke paas ek gaddha bhi tha, jahan se log kadhi hui schist jaisi mitti nikala karte the, jo laal, safed tatha peeli rangon me milti thi. Exam point: Tomaghat ke paas 'Fila mati' ki chikni peeli mitti kumharon ke kaam aati thi; usme mile patthar ke tukdon ko alag karne ke liye poori mitti paani me daali jaati thi tatha halki talchh alag ikattha ki jaati thi, jabki bhaari patthar niche baith jaate the.
